English.sick: I’m sorry you weren’t feeling well. Take care, and we’ll see you when you’re ready.
English.transport: Thank you for letting us know. Our team can talk through options with you.
English.work_schedule: Thanks for the update. We’ll help you find a way to catch up.
English.family: Thank you for sharing. We understand family comes first.
English.data_or_device_issue: Try the low-data recording option in My Programmes. Let us know if you need help.
English.will_watch_recording: The recording is available in My Programmes. Let us know if you need help.
English.distress_or_safety: Thank you for telling us. A member of our team will contact you.
English.wants_human: Thank you for reaching out. A member of our team will contact you shortly.
English.financial_hardship: Thank you for telling us. A member of our team will contact you about options.
English.complaint: Thank you for raising this. A member of our team will review it with you.
English.other: Thank you for your message. A member of our team will follow up.

Pidgin.sick: Sorry say you no too well. Take care, we go see you when you ready.
Pidgin.transport: Thank you for telling us. Our team fit talk with you about options.

Yoruba.sick: A dúró de ìlera rẹ. Máa tọ́jú ara rẹ, a ó sì rí ọ nígbà tó bá yá.
Yoruba.transport: Ẹ ṣé fún mímọ̀ fún wa. Ẹgbẹ́ wa lè bá yín sọ̀rọ̀ nípa àwọn àṣàyàn.

Hausa.sick: Yi haƙuri da rashin lafiya. Ka kula da kanka, za mu gan ka idan ka shirya.
Hausa.transport: Na gode da sanar da mu. Ƙungiyarmu za ta tattauna zaɓuɓɓuka da kai.

Igbo.sick: Ọ dị anyị nwute na ahụ adịghị gị mma. Lekọta onwe gị, anyị ga-ahụ gị mgbe ị dị njikere.
Igbo.transport: Daalụ maka ịgwa anyị. Ndị otu anyị ga-akọwara gị nhọrọ dị iche iche.
